verdict.rationale: Two first-party doc pages cover this story. Automations schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times, and the Computer 'Scheduled Tasks' feature runs agent tasks on schedules such as 'every weekday at 9' or 'hourly' and reports results. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documentation of schedule syntax and job management (editing, history, failure handling), and evidence of chaining multi-step workflows beyond a single scheduled prompt.
